BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

3. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.

4. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.

5. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

6. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

8. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.

9. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

11. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.

12. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Appropriate Technology in Building and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Scaffolding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.

7. C — Information and Communication Technology

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

10. B — CPU

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Appropriate Technology in Building; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Orthographic Projection; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Computer Aided Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Scaffolding; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
